claim_boundary: Project-new synthesis candidates; proposals and oracles receive zero score credit.

status_meanings.prioritized-replacement: Test only as a replacement for measured runtime work.
status_meanings.oracle-only: No implementation until a zero-credit upper-bound oracle passes.
status_meanings.infrastructure: Research control mechanism with no independent score claim.
status_meanings.parked: Recorded but not eligible for current execution.
status_meanings.rejected: Do not implement without materially new evidence.
